description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between perplexity and GPU memory ratio as a function of the recent sequence ratio percentage, with three distinct metrics plotted against the same x-axis. The x-axis, labeled “Recent Sequence Ratio (%)”, spans from 0 to 100 percent, with tick marks at regular intervals of 20, indicating a linear scale. The y-axis on the left, labeled “Perplexity”, ranges from 4.2 to 4.7, also on a linear scale, while the y-axis on the right, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio (%)”, ranges from 40% to 100%, also on a linear scale. The orange line with circle markers, labeled “Perplexity”, starts at approximately 4.6 on the left y-axis and decreases to about 4.3 before slightly increasing to around 4.4 near the end. The blue line with circle markers, labeled “GPU Mem. Ratio”, begins at approximately 42% on the right y-axis and rises sharply to nearly 100% at the end. The dashed blue line, labeled “Full Cache GPU Mem.”, remains constant at approximately 100% across the entire x-axis range.
